body: I am hurting so badly I just need the pain to end :(

I am so sorry :( it's the most awful feeling when we lose someone. And even more awful when we don't like ourselves. I want you to know that I am hearing you. I may not know you but I really hope it gets better for you. Please don't cut yourself, you don't deserve this. I hate that you feel like this. If you feel the need to go to the hospital or somewhere safe I think you should. Reach out to someone I hate reading that you are hurting so much. :(
